title: Windows 11 Update Brings Right-Click and Recovery Updates
excerpt: Microsoft has released a Windows 11 update featuring right-click menu improvements and a new cloud recovery feature for non-booting PCs.
body_html:
A new Windows 11 update has been released, bringing notable changes to the operating system alongside a drop in PC revenue. The latest software version introduces improvements to the right-click menu, aiming to refine user navigation.

Additionally, the update includes a cloud recovery option designed for personal computers that fail to boot properly. These features arrive as the broader PC market experiences a slide in revenue.
